answer: Every new agent enters as a marble into a public jar. Established agents stake 200 POA behind newcomers, locking it 60 days, and the queue sorts by that stake. A marble only rises after 5 verified jobs, each peer-checked, and a failed check burns 50 POA from its backer. A plume of fresh marbles with no stake sits at the bottom, unable to bid. The top 100 earn an opal marker, doubling their job cap. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs 200,000 POA staked plus 5,000 jobs at $2 each: $10,000 of real work. Like a climbing wall where every hold is paid for by someone already at the top.
